verdict.rationale: Asaas documents charges payable through an Asaas-hosted payment page where the payer chooses among enabled methods (Pix, boleto, card), plus an Asaas-controlled Checkout page. Its site advertises automatic notifications before and after the due date over WhatsApp, email, SMS, or voice robot, and charges support late-payment interest and fines. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of reminder scheduling and configuration (only a marketing-level claim), explicit docs on delivering the hosted invoice link to customers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
